how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-wetlands-03-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:304:obj:0: Kill ⟦E1⟧ and bring his ear to ⟦E2⟧ outside of Dun Modr.
rows.quest:304:details:0: Many of my soldiers died in the battle of Dun Modr. My own brother perished when the West Bridge over the Thandol Span was destroyed. Aye, the Dark Iron dwarves are a devilish breed. From what Roggo was able to gather, the leader of the thugs in the ⟦E4⟧ is a warlock named ⟦E1⟧. He is quite a coward, sending his soldiers to do his bidding but hides in his camp on Direforge Hill, to the southeast.
rows.quest:304:details:1: If you can find the spineless scum, slay him and bring me his ear. I will reward you, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:304:progress:0: Were you able to locate ⟦E1⟧ yet, ⟦2⟧? He has been evading us for quite some time.
rows.quest:304:completion:0: ⟦E1⟧ is finally dead. While his death will not bring back the many innocent dwarves who died needlessly by his hand, it will help to restore peace of mind to those who survived. With Balgaras dead, the remaining Dark Iron scum should be easy enough to manage. Now, we must wipe them out before a new leader is sent to these parts.
rows.quest:98297:title: Stopping the Cycle
rows.quest:98297:obj:0: Kill the Subdued Dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates for ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1302:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E6⟧ at Foothold Citadel in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1302:details:0: My brother James went with Lady Proudmoore across the sea. Last I heard, the fighting had settled down over there, and James was setting up an inn somewhere on the continent. Wherever he is, I'm sure he's doing good business. Damn fine cook he was.
rows.quest:1302:details:1: I haven't heard from him for a while now--too busy with his inn, I'd wager--but the clerk in ⟦E7⟧ could probably point you to him. Look for him on the top floor of that keep near the middle of the city. What's it called... Foothold Citadel, that's it.
rows.quest:1302:completion:0: ⟦E8⟧, ⟦E8⟧... Why does that name sound so familiar?
rows.quest:1302:completion:1: Of course! The Shady Rest Inn incident. If you have any information about what happened there, I would urge you to speak with ⟦E9⟧ about it. He's handling the investigation.
